findings.text: Acceptance covers cooperative local full-delivery protocol, not atomic Git/session locking, malicious evidence-store writers, production wave acceptance or release verification. Mutations after last observation remain outside supported atomicity.

source: exact immutable candidate clone, private linked Git worktrees and OS-temp session SQLite; authentic source-generated receipt, not reviewer merged HEAD
limitations: No production acceptance, publication, release gate or atomic cross-store lock asserted. Source result is immutable once committed; review commit is the independent anchor, not fabricated production admission. Existing historical held reviews retained.
